translations.Bloc de notas online: apunta una idea an: Online notepad: capture an idea before it slips away | PostisPop
translations.Escribe apuntes y listas en un bloc de n: Write notes and lists in a free online notepad. Learn how to save a backup and tell local notes apart from the notes in your account.
translations.Bloc de notas online: apunta una idea an: Online notepad: capture an idea before it slips away
translations.Un bloc de notas resulta útil cuando esc: A notepad is useful when writing something down should take less time than deciding where to save it. In PostisPop, you can open a blank note, write down an idea and return to it later. The board keeps several notes in view, so you do not need to open a separate document for every topic.
translations.Un ejemplo para llevarlo a la práctica: An example to put it into practice
translations.Reserva una nota para las ideas que toda: Keep one note for ideas that do not yet have a home. Avoid sorting every sentence as you write it: capture the information first.
translations.Al acabar el día, convierte cada idea út: At the end of the day, turn each useful idea into a specific action: call someone, look up a fact or develop a draft. Review anything you no longer need before deleting it.
translations.Descarga una copia JSON antes de borrar: Download a JSON backup before clearing browser data or changing devices. Without signing in, opening the website in another browser will not recover your local notes.
translations.¿Las notas locales aparecen en otro disp: Do local notes appear on another device?
translations.No. Las notas locales pertenecen a ese n: No. Local notes belong to that browser. You can view the notes in your account after signing in on another device.
translations.Si tu cuenta tiene acceso a recordatorio: If your account has access to reminders, open that option, choose the note and add a date and time. Check that the app confirms it has been saved.
translations.Los avisos de la web requieren PostisPop: Web alerts require PostisPop to be open and the device to be active. Closing the browser or putting the device to sleep may prevent or delay the alert.
translations.Puedes permitir las notificaciones del n: You can allow browser notifications to see the alert outside the tab. Any entitlements you already have are preserved; new Premium activations will be available soon.
translations.Empieza con seis notas gratuitas en este: Start with six free notes on this device. Sign in when you want to use your account. Local notes only move to the cloud if you confirm their import.
translations.Pizarra virtual: organiza ideas que nece: Virtual whiteboard: organize ideas you need to see together | PostisPop
translations.Descubre cómo usar una pizarra virtual c: Discover how to use a virtual whiteboard with colored notes to organize information, compare options and keep your next steps in view.
translations.Pizarra virtual: organiza ideas que nece: Virtual whiteboard: organize ideas you need to see together
translations.Una lista funciona bien cuando todo pert: A list works well when everything belongs in one sequence. A virtual whiteboard helps when you need to see connections: what is missing, what depends on another task and which decision you need to make. Use the space to explain your work, not just to store sentences.
translations.Empieza por una pregunta que la pizarra: Start with a question the board should answer. For example: what is left to do before delivering this project? Write a brief answer on each note.
translations.Define una convención de colores sencill: Choose a simple, consistent color scheme. One color can indicate open questions and another, confirmed actions. Do not rely on color alone: also add a word such as TO DO or DONE.
translations.Reordena las notas por importancia. En P: Reorder your notes by importance. In PostisPop, you can drag one note onto another to swap their positions. Seeing them together should help you choose your next step.
translations.¿Es necesario usar todos los colores?: Do I need to use every color?
translations.No. Dos o tres categorías suelen ser suf: No. Two or three categories are usually enough. Add a written label so the meaning stays clear without having to distinguish the colors.
translations.Notas adhesivas online: una idea por not: Online sticky notes: one idea per note | PostisPop
translations.Organiza apuntes con notas adhesivas onl: Organize your thoughts with online sticky notes. Use colors, short sentences and written labels to review your ideas with less effort.
translations.Notas adhesivas online: una idea por not: Online sticky notes: one idea per note
translations.Una nota adhesiva funciona mejor cuando: A sticky note works best when it expresses one thing. If it combines a reminder, a quote and a conversation, it will be hard to see what to do with it. Split the information by purpose and use titles you can understand at a glance.
translations.Empieza la nota con un verbo: revisar, e: Start the note with a verb: review, send, decide or ask. Add the details you need to act underneath.
translations.Usa etiquetas escritas como #casa, #trab: Use written tags such as #home, #work or #study. Search can find those words without creating folders or hiding the rest of your board.
translations.Dedica un minuto a revisar las notas ant: Take a minute to review old notes. You can export a note that no longer needs action before clearing it, keeping what matters today in view.
translations.En esta versión se escriben dentro de la: In this version, you write them inside the note, for example #work, and find them using search. There is no separate tag catalog.
translations.Pizarra colaborativa: prepara un espacio: Collaborative whiteboard: prepare a shared space with clear rules | PostisPop
translations.Prepara objetivos, tareas y permisos par: Prepare goals, tasks and permissions for a collaborative whiteboard. Check the actual status of PostisPop links and invitations.
translations.Pizarra colaborativa: prepara un espacio: Collaborative whiteboard: prepare a shared space with clear rules
translations.Antes de invitar a otras personas, defin: Before inviting other people, define what you expect from them: reading information, contributing ideas or changing decisions. A shared board needs a common goal and a way to distinguish proposals from agreements. Creating an account does not, by itself, mean sharing a board.
translations.Escribe el objetivo y el resultado esper: Write down the goal and expected outcome. One concrete example is finishing the session with three actions and a person responsible for each one.
translations.Establece quién puede editar y quién sol: Set out who can edit and who only needs to read. Review the participants when the project ends and avoid entering information that not everyone should see.
translations.En PostisPop, los enlaces y las invitaci: In PostisPop, links and invitations are under review. Until they are enabled and confirmed, you can prepare the content and share an export. That copy is not real-time collaboration.
translations.¿Puedo crear ahora un enlace editable?: Can I create an editable link now?
translations.La gestión de enlaces e invitaciones est: Link and invitation management is under review. This version does not present a link as active unless the server has confirmed it.
translations.Organizador visual de tareas: elige qué: Visual task organizer: choose what to do next | PostisPop
translations.Organiza tareas con una pizarra visual s: Organize tasks on a simple visual board. Separate tasks to do, work in progress and completed tasks while keeping the next step in view.
translations.Organizador visual de tareas: elige qué: Visual task organizer: choose what to do next
translations.Una pizarra de tareas debe ayudarte a de: A task board should help you decide, not just remind you how much is left. If all the notes look equally urgent, the organization is not solving the problem. Start with a few commitments and write down an action you can finish.
translations.Clasifica las tareas como POR HACER, EN: Classify tasks as TO DO, IN PROGRESS and DONE. Write the status on the note itself as well as using a color.
Limit your work in progress. If a task is blocked, add the reason and the next action: wait for a reply, ask for information or set aside time.
translations.Revisa los pendientes al empezar y termi: Review outstanding tasks at the start and end of the day. Use one note for each next step and leave room for the information you actually need.
translations.¿Necesito preparar una estructura antes: Do I need to set up a structure before writing?
translations.No. Abre una de tus seis notas gratuitas: No. Open one of your six free notes and start writing. You can organize your ideas later, once you know what works for you.
translations.Notas para estudiar: practica recordar,: Study notes: practice recalling, not just rereading | PostisPop
translations.Prepara notas de estudio con preguntas,: Prepare study notes with questions, examples and short reviews. Organize each session on a board you can view in your browser.
translations.Notas para estudiar: practica recordar,: Study notes: practice recalling, not just rereading
translations.Copiar una página entera en una nota cre: Copying a whole page into a note creates another page to read. To study actively, turn the content into questions. A board with brief concepts makes it easier to spot what you can explain and where you need to return to the original materials.
translations.Ejemplo · Aplícalo a un caso: Example · Apply it to a case
translations.Escribe una pregunta concreta en cada no: Write a specific question on each note: what is the difference between these two concepts? Try answering it before looking at the book.
translations.Añade un ejemplo propio. Si solo recuerd: Add an example of your own. If you only remember the definition, check whether you can apply it to a new situation. Mark unresolved questions with #review.
translations.Cierra la sesión con tres preguntas para: End the session with three questions for the next day. Adapt each note to your subject and keep backups of important study notes.
translations.¿PostisPop corrige o verifica mis apunte: Does PostisPop correct or verify my study notes?
translations.No. Es una herramienta para organizar no: No. It is a tool for organizing notes. Check the content against your study materials and sources.
translations.Pizarra para reuniones: de los temas a l: Meeting board: from topics to agreements | PostisPop
translations.Prepara una reunión con agenda, decision: Prepare a meeting with an agenda, decisions and next steps. Use a note board to give every agreement an owner and a date.
translations.Pizarra para reuniones: de los temas a l: Meeting board: from topics to agreements
translations.Una reunión resulta más fácil de seguir: A meeting is easier to follow when topics and decisions are kept separate. The board can serve as an agenda before the meeting and a record of agreements afterward. Avoid confusing an idea someone suggests with a decision the team has already made.
translations.Acción · Ana envía la propuesta el viern: Action · Ana sends the proposal on Friday
translations.Antes de la reunión, escribe para qué se: Before the meeting, write down why it is being held and which decision needs to be made. Limit the agenda to points that need discussion.
translations.Durante la sesión, anota cada decisión c: During the session, record each decision in specific words. Keep unanswered questions separate so they do not get lost among the comments.
translations.Al terminar, asigna una persona responsa: At the end, assign an owner and a date to every next step. Export the text to PDF using the print option if you need to distribute a copy; it does not contain attachments.
translations.¿La copia PDF se actualiza después de ex: Does the PDF copy update after export?
translations.No. Es una copia del texto guardado en e: No. It is a copy of the text saved at that moment. Export it again if you need to share later changes.
translations.Lluvia de ideas online: primero explorar: Online brainstorming: explore first, choose later | PostisPop
translations.Prepara una lluvia de ideas con un reto: Prepare a brainstorming session with a clear challenge, brief notes and a final selection. Organize proposals and turn them into a first experiment.
translations.Lluvia de ideas online: primero explorar: Online brainstorming: explore first, choose later
translations.Una lluvia de ideas tiene dos momentos d: Brainstorming has two distinct stages: suggesting possibilities and choosing which are worth trying. If you assess every idea immediately, it is easy to settle on the first options. Use notes to capture alternatives before comparing them.
translations.Formula un reto acotado. ¿Cómo podemos s: Define a focused challenge. How can we simplify sign-up? is more useful than improve the entire app. Write one proposal per note, even if it is still imperfect.
translations.Agrupa las propuestas parecidas mediante: Group similar proposals using words or colors. Look for options that solve the same problem with different levels of effort; do not discard an idea just because some details are still missing.
translations.Elige una prueba pequeña y escribe qué q: Choose a small test and write down what you want to learn. A useful decision ends with an action, a review date and an observable sign that the idea works.
translations.¿PostisPop decide cuál es la mejor idea?: Does PostisPop decide which idea is best?
translations.No. Te permite ver y comparar tus propue: No. It lets you see and compare your proposals. You choose the criteria and decide which experiment to run.
translations.Empieza con 6 notas gratis. Un único Pre: Start with 6 free notes. One Premium plan: €2.95 per month, €9.95 per year or €59.95 for life. Purchases coming soon.
translations.Tus notas son las protagonistas. Empieza: Your notes take center stage. Start for free and choose Premium when you need more room for your ideas.
Large, clear and always at hand.
Write and draw on the same note.
translations.Un único Premium. Elige cuánto tiempo qu: One Premium plan. Choose how long you want to enjoy it.
More than 6 notes, organized into pages.
translations.Una vista amplia para reconocer tus idea: A spacious view to recognize your ideas at a glance.
translations.Las herramientas de tus notas, sin compr: Your note tools, with no separate purchases.

translations.Premium mensual, 2,95 euros al mes. Próx: Monthly Premium, €2.95 per month. Coming soon

translations.No. Mensual, anual y de por vida dan acc: No. Monthly, yearly and lifetime options give access to the same Premium plan. Only the payment option changes.
translations.¿Puedo seguir usando PostisPop gratis?: Can I keep using PostisPop for free?
translations.Sí. Dispones de 6 notas gratis para escr: Yes. You have 6 free notes for writing and drawing. You do not need a card to get started.
translations.¿Qué ocurre con mis compras anteriores?: What happens to my previous purchases?
Any entitlements you already have are preserved. The new offer does not require you to buy again what is already yours.

Your ideas, on your device too.

translations.Abre PostisPop en Chrome. Usa el botón d: Open PostisPop in Chrome. Use the installation button when it appears or look for “Install app” / “Add to Home screen” in the menu.

translations.Abre PostisPop en Chrome y utiliza la op: Open PostisPop in Chrome and use the option to install the page as an app. The shortcut will appear among your apps.
Open PostisPop in Chrome and use the option to install the page as an app when it is available in your browser.
translations.Puedes seguir usando la pizarra sin inst: You can keep using the board without installing anything.
translations.La sincronización de tu cuenta necesita: Your account needs a connection to sync. Guest notes belong to the browser where you created them.
translations.Las aplicaciones nativas y los enlaces a: Native apps and store links will appear here when they are available and tested.
translations.Ayuda para escribir, dibujar, buscar y g: Help with writing, drawing, finding and saving your notes in PostisPop.
translations.Toca una nota y empieza a escribir. Tus: Tap a note and start writing. Your ideas are saved as you work.
translations.La nota se abre lista para escribir. Eli: The note opens ready for you to write. Choose the pencil or brush to draw on the same paper. Color changes, formatting and attachments are in the note menus.
translations.Busca por texto, color o #etiqueta. La b: Search by text, color or #tag. Search includes all pages. Use the arrows, the page selector or swipe horizontally on the board. In Settings, you can recover notes from the trash. In Advanced options, you can save and restore a backup.
translations.Sin cuenta, notas y adjuntos permanecen: Without an account, notes and attachments stay on this device. Save a backup before clearing browser data. A connection and an account are needed to sync or share; always check the save status.
translations.El candado de la nota permite cifrar tex: The note's padlock lets you encrypt text, drawings and local attachments with a password. Keep it separately: there is no password recovery.
translations.Gratis incluye seis notas. Premium estar: Free includes six notes. Premium will be available for €2.95/month, €9.95/year or €59.95 for life. Purchases are not enabled yet.

translations.Guardar, sincronizar y compartir las piz: Saving, syncing and sharing the boards you choose: performance of the service and actions you request.

translations.Para operar PostisPop podemos recurrir a: To operate PostisPop, we may use providers that process data under our instructions: Supabase for authentication, database and storage; Google for OAuth sign-in when you choose it; Resend for transactional emails; Cloudflare and hosting infrastructure for delivery, security and availability; and, if purchases are enabled, a payment provider such as Stripe. We may also disclose data when required by a competent authority or when necessary to establish, exercise or defend legal claims.
translations.Algunos proveedores pueden tratar inform: Some providers may process information outside the European Economic Area. In those cases, the safeguards required by applicable rules are used, such as adequacy decisions, standard contractual clauses or other valid mechanisms, together with appropriate technical and organizational measures.
translations.Conservamos los datos mientras tu cuenta: We retain data while your account remains active and for as long as necessary to provide the service. Security logs are kept for limited periods, and legal obligations may require certain data to be retained for longer. Deleted notes may temporarily remain in the trash or in backups before permanent deletion. When you request erasure, we will delete or anonymize the data unless we must retain it to comply with a legal obligation or defend legal claims.
translations.Puedes solicitar acceso, rectificación,: You may request access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability; you may also withdraw consent without affecting earlier processing. Write to us at
translations.indicando tu solicitud. Podremos pedir i: with your request. We may ask for reasonable information to verify your identity. If you believe we have not properly addressed your rights, you may complain to the

The service is not directed at children under 14; if we identify an account created without the required authorization, we may delete it. We do not make decisions with legal effects based solely on automated profiling.

translations.Condiciones aplicables al uso de PostisP: Terms governing the use of PostisPop.
translations.Estas condiciones regulan el acceso y us: These terms govern access to and use of PostisPop. By using the service, you accept these rules.
translations.PostisPop permite crear, organizar, sinc: PostisPop lets you create, organize, sync and share digital boards and notes. Some features may be offered in beta, evolve or become unavailable. We will inform you of significant changes when reasonable.
translations.Debes proporcionar información veraz, ma: You must provide accurate information, keep control of your credentials and notify us of any unauthorized access. You are responsible for activity carried out through your account, except where the law provides otherwise. You may use email and password or an available identity provider, such as Google.
translations.No puedes utilizar PostisPop para infrin: You may not use PostisPop to infringe third-party rights, distribute illegal content, harass others, introduce malicious software, bypass security measures, gain unauthorized access, perform abusive load testing or use the service in a way that harms other users or the infrastructure.

These terms do not transfer intellectual property rights, except for the limited and revocable right to use the service in accordance with them.
translations.Trabajamos para mantener el servicio dis: We work to keep the service available and secure, but interruptions, maintenance or losses caused by circumstances beyond our control may occur. We recommend keeping backups of important information. Nothing in these terms excludes nonwaivable consumer rights or liabilities that cannot legally be limited.
translations.Antes de cualquier compra mostraremos el: Before any purchase, we will show the price, applicable taxes, features and conditions. Payments will be managed by the provider identified during checkout. Where applicable, consumers retain their legal rights, including withdrawal, subject to the exceptions for digital content or services begun with express consent.
translations.Puedes dejar de usar el servicio y solic: You may stop using the service and request deletion of your account. Account deletion does not affect outstanding obligations or retention required by law.
translations.Estas condiciones se rigen por la legisl: These terms are governed by Spanish law, without prejudice to mandatory rules protecting consumers in their place of residence. Disputes will be submitted to the competent courts under applicable law. For questions or complaints, write to
translations.Una tirada gratuita por cuenta registrad: One free spin per registered account every Saturday, according to Madrid time. No purchase is necessary. Unused spins do not roll over. Each spin can award at most one prize, and its result is retained in the account.
translations.Durante los primeros seis sábados, conta: During the first six Saturdays, counted from the first completed spin, the overall chance of winning is 1 in 6. After 42 days, it becomes 1 in 10 and includes country designs. Visiting the website or signing up does not start this period.
translations.Tarjetas y saldo digital de 100 €: proba: €100 cards and digital credit: odds per spin in both stages
translations.Las seis marcas suman 6 entre 100.000 (0: The six brands total 6 in 100,000 (0.006%). These odds are included in the overall chance of winning, not added to it.
translations.La comparación con la Lotería Nacional s: The comparison with the Lotería Nacional refers only to matching the first-prize number: 1 in 100,000. It does not refer to winning any prize or to the prize amount. PostisPop is not associated with Loterías y Apuestas del Estado.
translations.También pueden obtenerse diseños no pose: You may also win designs you do not own, a reward credit if no designs remain available, and lifetime Premium. In the digital-prize branch, Premium has a 1 in 10,000 chance if the account does not already have Premium.
translations.Si ganas una tarjeta, el formulario de l: If you win a card, the prize-wheel form asks for your name and contact email to process it. The winning brand is recorded and cannot be changed. Saving the request does not mean the prize has been delivered. The format and regional availability will be confirmed during processing.
translations.iPhone 18 Pro y MacBook Air de 2026, con: iPhone 18 Pro and 2026 MacBook Air, with planned odds of 1 in 100,000 for each device. These devices are not yet included in the prize wheel. Their configuration and delivery terms will be published before they are activated.
translations.No se venden tiradas y los cobros están: Spins are not sold, and payments are disabled. Email reminders are not active yet. Brand names identify prizes and do not imply sponsorship or partnership.
translations.Puedes aceptar o rechazar la medición de: You can accept or reject measurement in “Measurement preferences”. If you accept, PostisPop sends events to its server for page views, control clicks, scrolling, active time and feature usage. Random browser and session identifiers are used to calculate return visits; they do not represent unique individuals. Note text, form values, email addresses and full IP addresses are not sent in these events.
translations.El identificador del navegador se renuev: The browser identifier is renewed after 90 days. You can withdraw consent using the same control. Reports for the last 30 days are reserved for the owner's account. Exits and timings are estimates affected by the connection, blockers and consent. Google Analytics and geographic data are not connected yet.

home.title: Free online sticky notes and idea board | PostisPop
home.description: Write ideas, organize tasks and draw on six free notes. Learn how to save, export and recover your notes in PostisPop on the web and Android.
home.heading: Your ideas in view, one note at a time.
home.intro: PostisPop is a sticky-note board for capturing ideas, preparing tasks and bringing together information you need to see side by side. You can start for free with six notes, without creating an account.

sections.heading: Write first. Organize later.
paragraphs: Open a note and start writing. Use one idea or action per note: a call to make, a study question or the next step of a project.
You can change the color, add a written tag such as #work and draw on the paper. Text and color search covers the different pages of the board. Protected notes do not reveal their content in search.

sections.heading: Understand where your notes are saved.
paragraphs: Without signing in, local notes and attachments stay in that browser and on that device. They do not automatically appear on another phone or computer. Clearing browser data can delete that local copy.

The notes in your account need a connection to sync. Check the save status: having a change saved on the device does not mean it has already been saved in the cloud. Local attachments from another device may not be available here.

sections.heading: Keep a backup before changing devices.
paragraphs: In “Advanced options”, save a JSON backup to preserve notes, drawings and attachments available on this device. Protected notes remain encrypted. Keep their passwords separately: there is no password recovery.

The PNG image includes all notes on the board up to a maximum of one hundred, with shortened text, colors and drawing strokes; it does not include attachments. Printing lets you save a copy of the text as a PDF. These exports do not replace a complete backup.

The web version supports backups up to 50 MB. The Android version saves files up to 10 MB. On Android, saving is only confirmed once the file has finished writing; canceling the picker does not download a backup.

sections.heading: Share with clear expectations.
paragraphs: Editable links and invitations are under review. You can prepare a board and share an export yourself, but that copy does not update when you change the notes.
Free includes six notes. Premium is planned at €2.95 per month, €9.95 per year or €59.95 for life. New purchases are not enabled yet.

sections.heading: Guides for putting your notes to use.
paragraphs: Check the guides to online notepads, virtual whiteboards and sticky notes to get started. You will also find suggestions for organizing tasks, studying, preparing meetings and developing a brainstorming session.
Each guide explains a practical use and the current limits of the tool. Choose a case that works for you, open your board and write down your first action.
